'''Selnesh''' was a notorious [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] a pale blue [[Star/Legends|star]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was a barren, gray, rocky world devoid of vegetation or [[Color/Legends|color]]. It had a single white, domed building, the [[Selnesh Imperial Detention Center]] from which the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Mission to Selnesh|rescued]] [[Gebnerret Vibrion]].
